name: Bardessono Hotel and Spa
positioning: Eco-minded, LEED Platinum-certified hotel and spa in the heart of Yountville, Napa Valley, on a former 1926 family homestead
best_for: Couples who want spa treatments in the privacy of their own room
Wine lovers looking for private tastings in Napa Valley
Travelers drawn to sustainable design, gardens and art

facts.text: Bardessono is in the heart of Yountville, in Napa Valley.
The property dates to 1926 and is the former homestead of Italian immigrants John and Lucy Bardessono.
The hotel, restaurant and spa opened in 2009.
A year after opening, the hotel was awarded LEED Platinum Certification by the US Green Building Council.
The grounds have zen-like gardens with small wooden footpaths and water features.
The hotel has an outdoor rooftop pool.
Accommodations are spa-inspired suites with private outdoor spaces.
Rooms are done in earth tones with pops of maroon and warm yellow, dark wood and leather.
B Spa has a private one-to-two-person sauna accessed via the locker room.
Salvaged Monterey Cypress, walnut and California Bay trees are used for exterior cladding on select buildings.
Guests can explore the area on a complimentary bike.
Lucy's Garden, kept by Lucy Bardessono, still exists on the grounds and serves as a culinary garden for Lucy Restaurant & Bar.

highlights.text: Each room is designed to transform into a private spa suite, with privacy screens and massage tables.
Bardessono was awarded Two Michelin Keys by the Michelin Guide in 2025.
The hotel showcases an expansive art collection with its partner, the San Francisco-based Andrea Schwartz Gallery.
In the Maple Grove Villa, guests can have one-on-one tastings with Master Sommelier Erik Elliott from Lawrence Wine Estates.
A spa butler can be arranged to draw a customized bath in the room's soaking tub.

considerations.text: Transportation in the house Lexus car is limited to within 2.2 miles to the north and 1.4 miles to the south.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site dining options.
